# Phase5 — approved recording and frontend handoff

User approved2026-10-01. Complete the existing run's evidence presentation,
not another live execution. Original financial mode sandbox; presentation kind
recorded_evidence_replay. No new provider calls, payments, wallet operations,
upstream writes, deployment, production hardening or final visual design.

Main owns frozen verified bundle, read-only replay server/reference screens,
actual browser frame capture,240-second captioned MP4/SRT/narration and runbook.
One Sol6.1high builder owns client/contracts/frontend fixture package. One fresh
Sol6.1high reviewer after integration checks reproducibility/claims; fix blockers
and do one bounded recheck. No broader audit cycle.

Acceptance: launcher runs without credentials/database/RPC; Previous/Next and
repeated reads cannot invoke delivery/model/payment routes. Six actual Jev
decisions, two organic app-bridge answers, two accepted deliveries, native
vouchers3000→6000 and finalized payout6000/refund14000 are correlated by IDs.
One funded advertiser is explicit. Synthetic competing/no-fill/failure/pending
examples are separate. Original Phase3/4 artifacts and databases are unchanged.
Actual historical profile hashes must match recorded decision provenance.

Resource gate: keep >=40GiB free per user's updated floor; video/frame outputs
bounded below500MiB. Existing installed FFmpeg/Node only, no large dependencies.
Recording may edit browser-frame hold durations, but cannot pretend a replay is
fresh execution. Captioned still-frame walkthrough and recorded timeline are
explicit; no generated animations stand in for actual run evidence.

Frontend specialist receives actual-route OpenAPI3.1/DTOs/client/fixtures and
screen map, existing PolySans/neutral/steel tokens. No browser financial authority.
Done means another person can launch offline and present the story without
credentials/spending, and specialist can start without inventing API behavior.
